note: Base: central glossary v2.83.0 (translation-glossary-2.83.0.json). Contents: 20 modify ops, all appliesTo extensions for isaiah-woh wave I2 (Isa 13, 14, 15, 29, 32, 40, 42, 43, 44, 45, 48, 54, 65). No new central entry, no wohChoice or rationale changed, no decision reversed, so a minor bump is recommended. Apply semantics as in the Kings and Revelation wave diffs: op=modify replaces each field in `changes`; appliesTo values are complete arrays preserving every refId of v2.83.0, and `appliesToAdded` lists the new refIds. CONCURRENCY: the exodus-woh / numbers-woh / deuteronomy-woh Editor and the Former-Prophets (joshua-woh / judges-woh / 1-samuel-woh) pass are producing central diffs from the same 2.83.0 base. If either is merged first, renumber this diff to the next free minor and re-base each appliesTo array as the union (merged array + this op's appliesToAdded); shamayim, eretz, yatsar, asah, olah-burnt-offering, qorbanot, pesel-utemunah, adam-adamah and avon are the likeliest overlaps. DELIBERATE NON-EXTENSIONS (recorded, not applied): bara (Genesis-scoped 'shape' NOT extended to Isaiah; Isaiah renders bārāʾ 'create' under the isaiah-woh overlay bara-create-isaiah; founder decision flagged); elohim-as-translation ('the Elohim' NOT extended; Isaiah's 'God' practice recorded in the overlay elohim-el-eloah-monotheistic-formula-isaiah; the 45:18 / 1 Kgs 18:39 divergence flagged); shaddai-eloah for Eloah at 44:8; el-elyon (14:14 'the Most High'); kokhvei-boqer (14:13 'the stars of God'); kimah-kesil-mazzarot-ayish (13:10 'their constellations'); tohu-vavohu (the pair; bare tōhû in the overlay); tzedakah-u-mishpat-justice-pair (32:16 split pair); nachash-arum (65:25, Gen 3:14 allusion only); chesed-solitary at 40:6 (human constancy).
scopeNoteAddendum: **v2.84.0 (Isaiah wave I2 — Isa 13-15, 29, 32, 40, 42-45, 48, 54, 65, the canon-cited oracles and Second/Third Isaiah):** appliesTo extensions only, for adam-adamah (+5), asah (+8), avon-iniquity-cross-corpus-keyword (+5), bi-nishbati-divine-self-oath (+1), bor-pit-cistern-dry-water-shaft (+2), brit-shalom-mishkan (+1), chesed-solitary-covenant-kindness (+2), eretz (+3), hineni-prophetic-response-formula (+1), kavod-yhwh (+1), mount-sapunu-tsafon-cosmic-mountain-cross-corpus-ugaritic-hebrew-bible (+1), nivrakhu-bekha-niphal-hithpael (+1), olah-burnt-offering (+2), pesel-utemunah-graven-image-iconographic-prohibition-cross-corpus (+10), qorbanot-sacrificial-offering-vocabulary-cluster-cross-corpus (+3), shaddai-eloah (+1), shamayim (+15), sheol-underworld-realm-of-the-dead (+3), tachat-substitution-formula (+2), yatsar (+16). The šāmayim register rule is applied book-wide: 'skies' for the physical and created sky (the horizon idiom of 13:5, the creation hymns of chs. 40-48, and the Gen 1:1 merism of 65:17 'new skies and a new earth'), 'the heavens' for the divine-council realm of 14:12-13. Isaiah keeps bārāʾ 'create' (overlay), not the Genesis 'shape'; that and the other Isaiah-specific decisions live in the isaiah-woh overlay v1.6.0.

appliesTo extension for the name Shaddai only: Isa 13:6 kᵉšōḏ miš-šadday 'like destruction from Shaddai' (= Joel 1:15), transliterated with NJPS so that the šōḏ / šadday paronomasia stays audible. The Eloah half of the entry is deliberately NOT extended to Isa 44:8 (hă-yēš ʾĕlôah mib-balʿāḏay 'Is there a God besides me?'), where ʾĕlôah is one of three synonyms (with ʾĕlōhîm 44:6 and ʾēl 45:21) in a single denial formula and is rendered 'God' under the isaiah-woh overlay elohim-el-eloah-monotheistic-formula-isaiah. The entry's Job-specific rationale is unaffected. Base array is the v2.83.0 array.

appliesTo extension only, applying the register rule ratified at the Kings wave-A sign-off (2026-11-01). 'skies' (wohChoice) for the physical sky: the horizon idiom miqṣēh haš-šāmayim 'from the end of the skies' (Isa 13:5, canon-cited; the stock idiom for the edge of the world, Deut 4:32; 30:4), 'the stars of the skies' (13:10), the shaken skies (13:13), the rain-giving skies parallel to šᵉḥāqîm 'clouds' (45:8), and the measured and stretched-out skies of Second Isaiah's creation hymns (40:12, 22; 42:5; 44:23, 24; 45:12, 18; 48:13), which are the made cosmos of the Gen 1 register. 'the heavens' (the entry's divine-realm register) at Isa 14:12-13, where the vow to ascend 'above the stars of God' to 'the mount of assembly' places šāmayim in the realm of the divine council. Isa 65:17 'new skies and a new earth' is the Gen 1:1 merism for the whole created order (same verb, same pair, rendered 'the skies and the earth' at Gen 1:1), not YHWH's dwelling (contrast 66:1 'the heavens are my throne'), and therefore takes 'skies'; the reception form 'new heavens' (2 Pet 3:13; Rev 21:1, 'a new heaven' in revelation-woh) is recorded in commentary and the register choice is flagged to the founder in wave-i2-editor-report.md. Base array is the v2.83.0 array.
appliesTo extension only: 'She'ol' (transliterated, wohChoice) at Isa 14:9, 11, 15 in the taunt over the king of Babylon. Base array is the v2.83.0 array.

appliesTo extension only: 'instead of' (wohChoice) at Isa 43:3 (taḥteḵā 'Cush and Seba instead of you') and 43:4 (taḥteḵā / taḥaṯ nap̄šeḵā), following the Isa 53:12 extension. Base array is the v2.83.0 array.

appliesTo extension only: yāṣar 'form' (wohChoice) across Isaiah's creation and idol-making language: the forming of Israel (43:1, 7, 21; 44:2, 21, 24), the formula 'before me no god was formed' (43:10), the idol-makers (44:9, 10, 12), the clay passages (29:16; 45:9, 11; book-level ruling in the isaiah-woh overlay yotser-potter-clay-image-isaiah: the absolute substantive hay-yôṣēr 'the potter' at 29:16, the suffixed participle 'the one who formed him'), the creation triads (45:7, 18) and the weapon 'formed' against Zion (54:17). The entry's rationale already names yôṣēr 'potter' (Jer 18:2-6) as the root's anchor. In Isaiah yāṣar stays distinct from bārāʾ, which the isaiah-woh overlay renders 'create' (bara-create-isaiah). Base array is the v2.83.0 array.
